1 .  By way of the present application, the appellant seeks condonation of delay of 64 days in filing the present appeal.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, delay of 64 days in filing the present appeal is condoned.

3. The application stands disposed of.
CRL.M.(BAIL) 111/2026 4.

By way of the present application, the applicant/appellant is seeking suspension of sentence, till the disposal of the present criminal appeal, awarded to him vide judgment dated 02.08.2025 and order on sentence dated 11.09.2025, passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-01 (POCSO),
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 25/03/2026 at 22:27:04 Central Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi whereby the applicant/appellant stands convicted in case arising out of FIR bearing no. 423/2016, registered at Police Station Roop Nagar, Delhi for the commission of offences punishable under Sections 376(2)/(N)/354/354A/377/506 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC') and Sections 6/10 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 B vs State Of Nct Of Delhi And Anr on 25 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49483779/
1 (hereafter 'POCSO Act').

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The applicant/appellant herein had been sentenced for the aforesaid offences to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a maximum period of 12 years and pay fine of Rs.5,000/-, and in default of payment of fine, to further undergo simple imprisonment for a period of one month.
The benefit of Section 428 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (hereafter 'Cr.P.C') was extended to the applicant/appellant.

5. The learned APP for the State fairly states that as per the nominal roll, the applicant/appellant has already undergone sentence of more than 09 years and 02 months, out of 12 years, excluding remission earned by him.

6. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant states that the applicant/appellant herein has prima-facie good case on merits and there is very likelihood that the applicant/appellant would succeed in the present appeal.
Therefore, it is prayed that the sentence awarded to him in the present case may be suspended during the pendency of the present appeal.

7. In light of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, and especially the fact that the appellant was already undergone sentence of more than nine years out of 12 years, the present application is allowed.

It is directed that the sentence awarded to the applicant/appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of the present appeal, subject to his furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs. 10,000/- with one surety bond This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 25/03/2026 at 22:27:04 of the like amount, subject to satisfaction of the learned Trial Court/Successor Court/Link Court/Duty Judge concerned on the following terms and conditions, subject to verification that the amount of fine be deposited with the learned Trial Court by the appellant:
i) The applicant/appellant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned Court.
ii) In case of change of residential address/contact details and phone number, the applicant/appellant shall promptly inform the same to the concerned Trial Court.
8. Accordingly, the present application stands disposed of.

9. List in due course.
10.
The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J MARCH 25, 2026/A
